Now there was a Benjamite, a powerful man, whose name was Kish son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah of Benjamin.
His wifeʼs name was Ahinoam daughter of Ahimaaz. The name of the commander of his army was Abner, the son of Saulʼs uncle Ner. Saulʼs father Kish and Abnerʼs father Ner were sons of Abiel.
